name: io.github.tonyyang0504/shopify_app_store-mcp
description: Shopify App Store (marketplaces): me, get_product, list_sales, list_refunds. Every tool maps to a do

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPIFY_APP_STORE_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Partner API client access token (Partner Dashboard > Settings > Partner API clients, with the View financials permission for transactions and Manage apps for app data); 'The API client access token must belong to the organization that you're querying'. Sent as X-Shopify-Access-Token (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/partner/latest).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPIFY_APP_STORE_ORGANIZATION_ID
environmentVariables.description: Partner organization id from the Partners Dashboard URL (https://partners.shopify.com/{organization_id}/...); part of every endpoint URL.
